{{short description|none}}{{Video game industry}}
{{Dynamic list}}This is a listing of top 30 largest video game publishers and developers by number of employees. [[Xbox (division)|Ubisoft]] is the largest video game employer in the industry, followed by [[Electronic Arts]] and [[Xbox (division)|Xbox]].

Some companies, such as [[Tencent]], [[Valve Corporation|Valve]], [[Warner Bros. Games]], and others, do not publicly disclose how many employees work specifically in their interactive entertainment or gaming divisions.
